title: Mom Realizes She’s Going to Prison for Child Abuse
description:
Bodycam footage shows the investigation into an Amber Alert issued after a 10-year-old went missing. New Mexico authorities said Angelique Sanchez drove off with her son after being granted a visit by his guardian. Albuquerque police safely rescued the boy, who was unharmed during the incident. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
